name: benchmark-v1

developers.description: Intermediate Python web developer: Django and DRF APIs on PostgreSQL, some Celery; wants backend web projects.
Intermediate frontend developer: React and TypeScript with Vite, some Next.js and Tailwind; wants UI libraries and frontend tooling.
Experienced Rust systems developer: async networking with Tokio, Serde, some C; interested in systems programming and developer tools.
Intermediate data engineer: Python, SQL, Airflow and pandas, some Spark and dbt; wants data pipeline and data quality projects.
Experienced Go infrastructure engineer: Kubernetes, Docker, Prometheus and Terraform; wants cloud-native and DevOps tooling.
Beginner web developer: plain JavaScript, HTML and CSS from a course, a little Python; wants first contributions to welcoming web projects.
